name: CICS-04S
description: This results deposit reproduces the archived CICS-04S constructed regular-simplex reference through dimension 8 and adds an explicitly dated dimension-9 evaluation. The archived result is reproduced byte-for-byte; all ten geometry/scale/recovery gates and three existing targeted tests pass. An independent Gram-matrix construction confirms dimensions 1–9. The package includes numerical results, repeated performance measurements, independent reference arrays, a figure, hashes, methods and scope limitations. Performance covers full campaigns 1–D for D=5 through 9, using 1,000 measured campaigns per size. This deposit is a numerical reference benchmark, not a claim of physical extra dimensions or emergent simplex formation. Private ICS Research Studio source and the separate B24–25 certificate are excluded.
